review.body:
Two moderation paths need changes before merge: age-review enforcement failures must not look successful, and combined delete must preserve audit state across partial failure. Both are normal moderator actions, so the PR needs to make these failure modes visible and recoverable.

---
**Additional required changes**

- **Surface failed account enforcement** ([src/components/AgeReviewDetail.tsx:100](https://github.com/divinevideo/divine-relay-manager/blob/070b21948b8eb2398e3a3cac76975abd4775b08b/src/components/AgeReviewDetail.tsx#L100))
  Treat `keycastUpdated: false` as a failed moderation action here.
  The worker can persist the case change and still return 200 when Keycast suspension or ban fails, so the UI currently tells the moderator the action worked while account enforcement did not happen.
  Show a retryable error, or change the API contract so required account enforcement failures fail the state transition.
- **Preserve audit state for partial deletes** ([src/components/EventActions.tsx:176](https://github.com/divinevideo/divine-relay-manager/blob/070b21948b8eb2398e3a3cac76975abd4775b08b/src/components/EventActions.tsx#L176))
  Preserve an audit record as each irreversible side effect succeeds in this combined delete flow.
  The event delete and deletion-request publish can both complete before media deletion or the final decision log fails, which leaves the mutation in a failed state after moderation work has already happened.
  Log completed side effects immediately, or return a partial-success result that refreshes the UI and makes the audit trail explicit.

issue.title: task: wire age review actions to Keycast account suspension
issue.body:
## Context

Keycast PR #235 (account suspension) merged May 20. Keycast now exposes `GET/PUT /api/admin/users/:pubkey/status` with service-token auth. Status values: `active`, `suspended`, `banned`. Suspended users cannot sign events or decrypt DMs via the signer.

Relay-manager's age review system currently restricts accounts by age-restricting media (Blossom) and optionally banning the pubkey (Funnelcake). This is effective but imprecise: media restriction hides existing content, but the user can still post new events via any client that doesn't use Keycast signing. With Keycast suspension, the restriction is authoritative.

## What

When a moderator transitions an age review case to a restricted state (`restricted_pending_user_response`, `restricted_pending_support_email`):
- Call `PUT /api/admin/users/:pubkey/status` with `{ status: "suspended", suspended_reason: "age_review" }`

When a moderator clears the case (`clear`):
- Call `PUT /api/admin/users/:pubkey/status` with `{ status: "active" }`

When a case expires (cron auto-close with deny outcome):
- Keep suspended (no unsuspend call)

## Prerequisites

- `KEYCAST_SERVICE_TOKEN` secret set on relay-manager staging + production
- `KEYCAST_URL` env var (probably `https://login.divine.video`)

## Acceptance criteria

- Restricting an account in age review suspends the user in Keycast
- Clearing a case unsuspends the user in Keycast
- Keycast call failure does not block the age review state transition (graceful degradation -- log the error, continue)
- Integration test covering the suspend/unsuspend calls

## Related

- Keycast PR divinevideo/keycast#235 (merged)
- Relay-manager PR #78 (deletion alignment, in review)
- Under-16 coordination doc: `docs/moderation/under-16-system-coordination.md`

comment.body:
Fixed in b4b9f3e. Replaced `clearedRestrictedState` (which required the immediately prior state to be restricted) with an unconditional check on `requestedState === 'cleared'`. Both `unsuspendUser` and `un-age-restrict-all` are idempotent, so they fire on every clear regardless of prior state.

Added regression tests for `restricted_pending_*` → `submitted_for_review` → `cleared` and `needs_follow_up` → `cleared`.

review.body: The Keycast account state must be fixed before merge. Clearing an age review case can currently leave the account suspended after the case moves through review or follow-up states.

comment.body:
Make the clear transition unsuspend accounts that already passed through a restricted age-review state, not only accounts whose immediately previous state is restricted.
A normal path is `restricted_pending_*` -> `submitted_for_review` or `needs_follow_up` -> `cleared`, and the middle transition intentionally leaves Keycast suspended.
With the current `clearedRestrictedState` check, the final clear skips `unsuspendUser` and leaves the account suspended after the case is cleared.
Add a regression test for `restricted_pending_*` -> `submitted_for_review` -> `cleared`, and cover `needs_follow_up` if that path can also follow a suspension.

issue.title: feat: realign moderation actions with explicit delete and age review workflows
issue.body:
## Summary

Implementing the under-16 age review enforcement layer (support-trust-safety#138) exposed that moderation actions were inconsistent across surfaces and the line between reversible actions (ban, block, restrict) and permanent ones (delete) was blurred -- deletion was only available as a sub-option of "Block & Delete" rather than a deliberate, standalone choice. This PR realigns moderation actions and makes the reversible/permanent distinction explicit, particularly for content take-downs and age review case resolution.

The action buttons in ReportDetail had grown to ~2200 lines of inline mutations, confirmation dialogs, and verification logic. Rather than bolt more onto that, we extracted composable `EventActions` and `UserActions` components that are now shared across Reports, Events, Users, and Age Review -- same actions, same confirmation flows, same visual distinction between reversible (outline) and irreversible (red, two-click) operations everywhere.

**What's new:**
- DELETE as a first-class media action (Blossom) and NIP-09 kind 5 event deletion (Funnelcake)
- Bulk content operations via `/api/bulk-moderate` (age-restrict all, delete all for a pubkey)
- Age review deny/expire can auto-delete all user content (configurable toggle in Settings)
- Manual delete fallback in age review when auto-delete is disabled
- `DeleteConfirmDialog` requiring typed confirmation for all irreversible actions
- Composable `EventActions` and `UserActions` replacing ~1100 lines of inline action code in ReportDetail

Relates to divinevideo/support-trust-safety#138

## Prerequisite

divinevideo/divine-moderation-service#147 (one-line change adding `DELETE` to `validActions`) must deploy before Blossom media deletion works. Everything else (NIP-09 deletion, bulk operations, UI) works independently.

## New files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/components/EventActions.tsx` | Composable event-level actions (ban/restore, media block/restrict/delete) |
| `src/components/UserActions.tsx` | Composable user-level actions (ban/unban, bulk age-restrict, bulk delete) |
| `src/components/DeleteConfirmDialog.tsx` | Two-click confirmation dialog for destructive actions |
| `worker/src/bulk-moderate.ts` | Server-side bulk moderation (fetches user events, applies action to all media) |

## Verification

**Local (dev server, no worker):**
- [x] All tabs render without crashes (Reports, Age Review, Events, Users, Settings)
- [x] AgeReviewSettings toggle renders in Settings with description text
- [x] Age Review tab renders case list with Active/Closed/All filters

**Automated:**
- [x] 97 tests pass, 0 failures
- [x] eslint clean
- [x] tsc --noEmit clean

**Needs staging deploy:**
- [ ] ReportDetail action buttons (EventActions/UserActions) with a real report
- [ ] EventModeration banned events list with EventActions
- [ ] UserManagement selected user with UserActions
- [ ] AgeReviewDetail deny flow with auto-delete confirmation
- [ ] DeleteConfirmDialog two-click flow
- [ ] Bulk operations hitting the worker

issue.body:
Two improvements to keep Zendesk and relay-manager age review clocks in sync:

1. **Create Zendesk ticket at case creation/restriction**, not just at parent contact submission. Agents should see the case in Zendesk from the start.

2. **Set the Age Review Deadline custom field** on the ticket using the `deadline_at` value from the relay-manager case. Keeps the Zendesk queue's deadline column populated and in sync with the authoritative relay-manager clock.

Relay-manager clock remains authoritative (auto-closes expired cases). Zendesk deadline field provides agent visibility in their existing workflow.

Future consideration: sync clock pause/resume to the Zendesk deadline field. Lower priority since agents see the parent reply in the ticket itself.

issue.title: Age review: Zendesk integration for parent contact workflow
issue.body:
## Context

PR #67 adds the age review clock — 15-day case management for under-16 reports. When a flagged user submits their parent's email via the mobile app, the email is saved to the case and the clock pauses. Currently, the moderator sees the email in the admin UI and handles outreach manually.

This issue adds Zendesk automation so parent contact is tracked as a ticket with proper threading, SLA, and reply detection.

## Scope

### Outbound: auto-create Zendesk ticket on parent email submission

When `POST /v1/minor-review-cases/{caseId}/parent-contact` saves the parent email:

- Create a Zendesk ticket addressed to the parent email
- Template body explains the situation, asks parent to reply to verify
- Tag the ticket `age-review` + include case ID in a custom field or internal note
- Use existing Zendesk API patterns from `worker/src/index.ts` (ticket creation, custom fields)
- Non-blocking: ticket creation failure should not fail the parent-contact endpoint (log + continue)

### Inbound: webhook on parent reply

- New endpoint: `POST /api/zendesk/age-review-reply` (sits alongside existing `/api/zendesk/` routes, uses Zendesk webhook auth)
- Zendesk trigger: when a ticket tagged `age-review` receives a new reply from the requester, fire webhook
- Handler matches ticket to case (by case ID in custom field or by requester email lookup)
- Updates case: log that parent contact was received, optionally transition state to `submitted_for_review`
- Moderator still makes the final clear/deny decision

### Zendesk-side configuration

- New trigger: "Age review — parent replied" (condition: tag `age-review`, requester replied)
- Webhook target pointing at `POST /api/zendesk/age-review-reply` on the worker
- Custom field or tag convention for linking ticket to case ID
- Email template for outbound parent notification

## Dependencies

- PR #67 (age review clock) must be merged first
- `ZENDESK_API_TOKEN` and `ZENDESK_EMAIL` env vars (already available on the worker for existing Zendesk integration)

## Not in scope

- Auto-closing cases based on Zendesk ticket resolution (moderator decision stays manual)
- Parent identity verification beyond "they replied to the email"
- Multi-language email templates (English only for MVP)
